sections.text:
The purpose of this procedure is to 
provide detailed safe method for transmission lines maintenance staff to 
minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment 
,and Washing Live Transmission Lines 500KV tension Insulators Using Russian 
Equipment.

items:
A work permit must be issued
 comprising the work location, towers numbers, date and time, as well as
 names of the linemen and the degree of safety rate for each.

Ensure the pressure of water pump,
 must be not less than 10 atmospheric pressure.

Ensure the specific dielectric
 resistance of water used, must be not less than 400 ohm/cm

Ensure the wind speed meter must be
 established at a distance of 20 m outside the tower.

Ensure the wind speed and direction,
 must not exceed than the following values:

8 m/sec for ordinary tension
 towers and angle towers of inclination from 0 to 20 degrees

6 m/sec for angle towers of
 inclination from 20 to 45 degrees

4 m/sec for angle tension towers
 of inclination greater than 45 degrees.

Check the adequacy of communication
 means with the specific control center.

Work should stop immediately in case
 of any change in weather conditions such as storms, mist or rain.

The supervisor must make sure that
 there are no broken or damaged insulator disks in the insulators strings.
 The cleaning process must not take place where there are less than 17 desks
 of good condition.

Work should stop immediately if the
 circuit becomes de-energized due to the washing process or any other reason.

All Equipment should be provided
 with an earth cable of cross section not less then 150 mm2 or two
 cables not less than 75 mm2.

Telescopic tower car (26 meter height) branch with 17mm nozzles, fixed on
 a special support in the basket of telescope and covered by protective
 shield-cage, rubber hose rated at 10 atmospheric pressure and 40 meter long.

A pump to draw waters from the tank and drives it through the hose with a
 pressure not less than 10 atmospheric pressure (BAR).
A vehicle equipped with a water tank of a capacity about 5 m3.
A waterproof coat.
A wind meter.
Field glasses (Binoculars).
Goggles.
Non conductive gloves for the working individuals.

Earth cables to ground the washing equipment (Telescope, Water truck, and
 water pump)

The supervisor should specify the
 proper position of each piece of equipment especially the telescopic vehicle
 as illustrated in figure 1. He should also identify the work sequence on
 each phase according to the wind speed and direction, as mentioned in safety
 precautions.

Work must proceed depending on the
 wind direction so that the water would flow avoiding any water splash on the
 insulators, which arent cleaned yet.

Washing of tension towers insulators
 is usually completed as the telescope is moved along 8 Positions as in
 Figure 2. Start the washing process at the farthest insulator in the
 direction of wind given that water must flow in a direction opposite to that
 of the wind to avoid any splash of water on the insulators yet to be
 cleaned.

Place the telescope vehicle and the
 rest of equipment at the line comprising location no. 1 at a distance of 15
 m from the towers axis given that it is the farthest line in wind direction
 as for the telescope vehicle it must be placed at location no. 1. (i.e. 6.5
 m away from each phase).

The telescopic vehicle jacks must be lowered to the ground, and the earth
 cables of the equipment are connected to the tower legs. The hose attached
 to the water pump must also be connected to the telescope.

The washing technician must climb to the basket of the vehicle. raised and
 leveled to the ground and the telescope pillar is then raised taking into
 consideration that its inclination from the main axis must not exceed three
 degrees. Also take care that its height must not exceed than:
12 to 13 meters in the case of tension towers type A
17 to 18 meters in the case of tension towers type A+5

sections.text:
In both cases, the length of the water column must never
 be less than 8m in length, and the height of the telescope must make it
 possible for the washing technician to have a full view of all three
 insulator strings in a parallel position.

items:
Turn on the water pump when the washing technician gives a starting signal
 to the work supervisor. Then the cleaning process will takes place by
 washing the first half insulators strings of phase A, facing the High Dam,
 which are insulators no 1, 2, 3 consecutively (the insulators strings are
 numbered according to the numeration of the High Dam - Cairo Line 500KV as
 illustrated in document no. TD-TL-004- -r0. The water stream must flow
 starting from the conductor towards the towers body to the midpoint of the
 insulator string, and three or four disks of the three strings are washed
 consecutively till half the disks are cleaned taking into consideration that
 each 30 disks are cleaned in 40 seconds.

Turn off the water pump when the washing technician gives a stopping
 signal to the supervisor. The supervisor must ensure that all insulators are
 well cleaned using field glasses from a spot where it is possible for him to
 see all the insulator disks.

Wash the insulators no. 4, 5, 6 at location no. 2 similar to insulators no
 1, 2, 3 at location no.1 following the previous procedures and taking into
 consideration the same Safety Precautions used before.

Washing the no. 2-1, 3-1, 4 Loop suspension insulators string of phases A,
 B, C facing the High Dam must take place at sites 2, 3, 4 consecutively
 given that the water column must be moved upwards along those strings from
 the conductor up to the towers top.

After washing all the insulators facing the High Dam, the taps of the pump
 and the tank must be turned off and the hose disconnected from the vehicle.
 All earthing cables that hinder the transfer of equipment must also be
 disconnected and equipment are then moved slowly, (i.e. with a velocity not
 more than 4 km/hour), to the other side of the tower (that facing Cairo)

Insulators strings facing Cairo direction must washed from sites no 5, 6,
 7, 8 consecutively. Taking the same steps and precautions except for the
 direction of the water column movement, as it must be moved along the
 tension strings in a direction opposite to that of the wind according to the
 common rule.

After washing all the towers insulators mentioned in the work order, taps
 of the pump and the tank must be turned off, the hose and the earthing
 cables be disconnected. Then the equipment moved away from the towers outer
 phase by 25 m, then the telescope is then restored to its initial position
 to be moved to another tower taking into consideration that the vehicles
 must not be moved under the energized lines conductors.
